bEzlW0uCsrcVgjkb1Ij05A.en: The GPEI reported that during 6–12 August, cVDPV1 added 1 case in South Sudan, and cVDPV2 added 1 case each in Nigeria and Somalia. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 15 detections in two countries: 10 in Pakistan and 5 in Afghanistan. cVDPV1 added 1 detection in South Sudan; cVDPV2 added 5 detections in three countries: 3 in Somalia, and 1 each in Libya and Nigeria; and cVDPV3 added 1 detection in Nigeria.

RNw-_jMwNJPWhyPylKP8Cg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 21 and 27 May, WPV1 added one case in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 added one case each in Madagascar and South Sudan; cVDPV2 added two cases in Somalia; and cVDPV3 added three cases in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 11 specimens in Afghanistan and cVDPV2 added three in Somalia.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

UVVBAxzkUtpm5z9jamUHOg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 2–8 April, cVDPV2 cases were newly reported in three countries, totalling five cases: three in Nigeria, and one each in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Somalia. For environmental samples, WPV1 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling 11 samples: seven in Pakistan and four in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 environmental detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling six samples: five in Sudan and one in Nigeria.

dPF6pz0YCJAp3gazmNLZlQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 March, WPV1 added one case in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 added four cases in three countries: two in Nigeria, and one each in Angola and Somalia. For environmental samples, WPV1 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling 27 samples: 20 in Afghanistan and seven in Pakistan. cVDPV2 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling two samples: one each in Chad and Somalia.

oLNkb0x3Xp-ZH6udyuQGbQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/26-3/4期間,cVDPV2新增2國共5例,分別為奈及利亞4例及查德1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為馬拉威/索馬利亞各1件。
oLNkb0x3Xp-ZH6udyuQGbQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 26 February–4 March, cVDPV2 newly reported five cases in two countries: four in Nigeria and one in Chad. For environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported two samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported two samples in two countries: one each in Malawi and Somalia.

9scQginTQg7qAoomIcoPxA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2025年12/25-31期間,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞1例;環境樣本部分,新增索馬利亞cVDPV2 1件。
9scQginTQg7qAoomIcoPxA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 25–31 December 2025 that cVDPV2 added 1 case in Somalia. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 1 sample in Somalia.

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

TLPiHatdVzJgIYfcRA3hsg.zh: 索馬利亞今年迄今累計報告1,600餘例,死亡87例,病例數為去(2024)年總數2倍,病例多集中於該國東北部邦特蘭州;索馬利蘭薩納州爆發疫情,報告約20例疑病例及3例死亡,索勒州報告30例疑病例及1例死亡,由於該國疫苗覆蓋率低,且用於疫苗接種及醫療資源之資金減少,導致該國疫情迅速上升。
TLPiHatdVzJgIYfcRA3hsg.en: Somalia has reported more than 1,600 cases this year, with 87 deaths; case numbers are twice last year's total (2024), and most cases are concentrated in the north-eastern Puntland state. An outbreak has occurred in Sanaag region of Somaliland, with about 20 suspected cases and 3 deaths reported; Sool region reported 30 suspected cases and 1 death. Because the country's vaccination coverage is low and funding for vaccination and medical resources has decreased, the outbreak has risen rapidly.

88JUj8ae2IZk5RYSdhwg0w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/4-10期間,cVDPV2新增3國共7例,分別為奈及利亞4例、查德2例、索馬利亞1例;cVDPV3新增查德1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增4國共5件,分別為查德2件、阿爾及利亞/索馬利亞/坦尚亞各1件。
88JUj8ae2IZk5RYSdhwg0w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 4–10 September, circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) cases increased by seven across three countries: Nigeria (4), Chad (2) and Somalia (1). cVDPV3 increased by one case in Chad. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 detections increased by five across four countries: Chad (2), and Algeria, Somalia and Tanzania (1 each).

d8gX5av6mRFJI6O7-R_w1g.zh: 索馬利亞首都摩加迪沙及週邊地區,自去(2024)年6月迄今年8月間病例數快速攀升,今年迄今已報告497例及42例死亡,相較去年(49例/13例死亡)為高。
d8gX5av6mRFJI6O7-R_w1g.en: In Mogadishu, Somalia's capital, and surrounding areas, case numbers have risen rapidly from June 2024 to August 2025. This year to date, 497 cases and 42 deaths have been reported, higher than last year's figures of 49 cases and 13 deaths.

2OHXGoLwCSWJpMDx6m-A9Q.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/8-14期間,cVDPV2型新增4國共9例,分別為衣索比亞5例、蘇丹2例、布吉納法索/象牙海岸各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦11件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加3國共5件,分別為阿爾及利亞3件、查德/索馬利亞各1件。
2OHXGoLwCSWJpMDx6m-A9Q.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 8 and 14 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 9 in 4 countries: 5 in Ethiopia, 2 in Sudan, and 1 each in Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 11 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 5 across 3 countries: 3 in Algeria, and 1 each in Chad and Somalia.

CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/13-19期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共6例病例,分別為索馬利亞4例、安哥拉/奈及利亞各1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦12件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增7國共13件,分別為葉門5件、吉布地3件、安哥拉/查德/象牙海岸/衣索比亞/索馬利亞各1件。
CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 March, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 4 in Somalia, and 1 each in Angola and Nigeria. For environmental samples, 12 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 7 countries: 5 in Yemen, 3 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Angola, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia and Somalia.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年截至9/26累計報告21萬8,258例病例,其中19,454例確診,2,968例死亡(CFR:1.25%),以剛果民主共和國8.5萬餘例、衣索比亞2.7萬餘例最多,另有蒲隆地、摩洛哥、奈及利亞、布吉納法索及索馬利亞報告1萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,19國報告數十至5千例不等。 越南南部胡志明市疫情上升,9月底單週新增近百例病例,自疫情爆發(時間不明)截至9/26累計報告達743例,多為5歲以下兒童,當局表示該市之免疫覆蓋率於各地區差異大,目前已超過72%;另報載該國中、北部省份疫情亦在上升。
Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
